messages:
lina.approvals: Quick thread : evaluating MatchLedger and InvoiceMesh for our invoice/usage reconciliation POC. Must-haves: per-request line items, export to GCS Parquet, daily partitioning, and a documented dispute/credit SLA.

derek.sourcing: Agreed. Also confirm timezone normalization (UTC) and currency conversion fields.

omar.engineering: Tech check: need request_id, model_name, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, and webhooks with replay. If export is aggregated only, it's a blocker.

sophia.billing: Pricing snapshot: MatchLedger = $0.019/1k tokens + $900/mo; InvoiceMesh = $4.5k/mo commit up to 150M tokens, overage $0.017/1k. Need cost model.

legal-bot: Reminder: attach SOC2 + DPA, require 30-day export window on termination and 72h breach notice.

lina.approvals: Action items: Derek negotiate 60-day pilot cap and onboarding waiver; Omar validate exports; Sophia build 12mo/24mo cost comparison. Update ticket PR-2026-0811. End of thread.
